# Urban Rasoi

100% vegetarian party catering in Kolkata. FSSAI-licensed kitchen at AE-287, Salt Lake Sector 1, Kolkata 700064 (22.59112, 88.40403). Cooking for house parties, grazing tables, offices and pujas since 2015. Delivery radius about 20 km.
